svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Trackside Sky Edit
svg.desc: An editorial desktop website concept with the original transparent Driver Dreamer logo directly on blue sky. The untinted full-width Ferrari 458 Italia photo is paired with oversized navy Futura typography, quiet white copy on the open left racecourse, a red circular-arrow action, and a model rail below the visible wheels. One white collection section and a racing-red footer complete the page. The red-footer logo retains its original crest without a backing plate.

g.text: FOR THE CARS THAT STAY WITH YOU

text.tspan: Make a place for your next dream.

g.text: RED EXTERIOR / TAN INTERIOR / SILVER WHEELS

text.tspan: Turn a passing obsession into a personal collection.

See which one speaks to you.
